_help: Card perks shown in the Perks tab. Each perk has a category (Hotels, Car rental, Lounges, Dining, Shopping, Other), English and 繁體 (_zh) text, and url: the page where a cardholder signs up for or uses that perk. Optional links: [{name, url}] for a perk with several sign-up pages. build.py makes 简体. Check each url still works when you edit. where: the places the perk applies to (hk, sg); scope_by gives a card's scope text per place.

cards.name: Visa Infinite
cards.scope: Visa's own Infinite perks in Asia Pacific. Links go to Visa's benefit pages; your bank adds its own perks (lounges, insurance, rewards).
cards.scope_zh: Visa 在亞太區的 Infinite 網絡禮遇。連結前往 Visa 禮遇頁面；發卡銀行另有自家禮遇（貴賓室、保險、獎賞）。

perks.title: Visa Luxury Hotel Collection
perks.what: Luxury hotels with daily breakfast for two, a US$25 hotel credit, and room upgrade and late check-out when available.
perks.what_zh: 豪華酒店每日兩位早餐、25 美元酒店消費額，並視乎情況免費升級及延遲退房。

perks.title: GHA DISCOVERY Titanium
perks.what: Instant Titanium status at GHA hotels such as Kempinski, Anantara and Pan Pacific.
perks.what_zh: 即時獲得 GHA 酒店（Kempinski、Anantara、Pan Pacific 等）Titanium 會籍。

perks.title: HoteLux Elite Plus
perks.what: A free year of HoteLux Elite Plus: luxury hotel rates that can include breakfast and hotel credits.
perks.what_zh: 免費一年 HoteLux Elite Plus 會籍：豪華酒店優惠價，或包早餐及酒店消費額。

perks.title: IHG One Rewards fast track
perks.title_zh: IHG One Rewards 快速升級
perks.what: A fast track to IHG One Rewards elite status when you stay with your Visa card.
perks.what_zh: 以 Visa 卡入住，可快速升級 IHG One Rewards 精英會籍。

perks.title: Avis President's Club
perks.what: Avis President's Club status: priority service, a car upgrade and a free additional driver at participating locations.
perks.what_zh: Avis President's Club 會籍：優先服務、升級車款及免費加一位司機（參與分店適用）。

perks.title: Extended warranty
perks.what: Extra warranty cover on eligible purchases, insured by AIG.
perks.what_zh: 合資格購物可享額外保養保障，由 AIG 承保。

perks.title: Trip.com Diamond
perks.what: A status match to Trip.com Diamond membership, plus money off selected flights.
perks.what_zh: 配對 Trip.com Diamond 會籍，另享指定機票折扣。

perks.title: Travel eSIM
perks.what: Free travel data on a Travelgoogoo eSIM.
perks.what_zh: 免費 Travelgoogoo eSIM 旅遊數據。

perks.title: The New York Times
perks.what: A free one-year subscription to The New York Times.
perks.what_zh: 免費訂閱《紐約時報》一年。

perks.title: Visa Infinite Golf
perks.what: Free rounds at selected golf courses in Asia. Booking opens on the 2nd of each month.
perks.what_zh: 亞洲指定高爾夫球場免費打球，每月 2 日開放預約。

perks.title: Visa Concierge
perks.what: A 24/7 assistant for restaurant bookings, trip plans and gifts.
perks.what_zh: 24 小時禮賓服務，代訂餐廳、安排行程及禮品。

perks.title: Agoda hotel discount
perks.what: Money off selected hotels when you book on Agoda with your Visa card.
perks.what_zh: 以 Visa 卡於 Agoda 預訂指定酒店可享折扣。

perks.title: Visa offers in Hong Kong
perks.what: Current Visa deals at Hong Kong shops, restaurants and hotels.
perks.what_zh: Visa 在香港商店、餐廳及酒店的最新優惠。

hk.scope: Visa Hong Kong lists its concierge and offers. Your bank adds the rest (lounges, insurance, rewards).
hk.scope_zh: Visa 香港提供禮賓服務及優惠，其餘禮遇（貴賓室、保險、獎賞）由發卡銀行提供。

sg.scope: Visa Singapore's Infinite perks. Your bank adds its own (lounges, insurance, rewards).
sg.scope_zh: Visa 新加坡的 Infinite 禮遇。發卡銀行另有其他禮遇（貴賓室、保險、獎賞）。

cards.name: Visa Infinite Privilege
cards.scope: A new tier above Visa Infinite, now reaching Asia Pacific (in Singapore, cards like DBS Insignia and UOB Reserve). Ask your bank which tier your card is.
cards.scope_zh: 比 Visa Infinite 更高的新級別，正逐步推出亞太區（新加坡如 DBS Insignia、UOB Reserve）。請向銀行查詢你的卡屬哪個級別。

perks.title: Visa Luxury Hotel Collection
perks.what: Breakfast for two, upgrade and late check-out when available, and a US$100 credit at about 200 top hotels.
perks.what_zh: 兩位早餐、視乎情況免費升級及延遲退房，約 200 間頂級酒店更有 100 美元消費額。

perks.title: HoteLux Elite Plus
perks.what: A free year of HoteLux Elite Plus for luxury hotel rates with extras.
perks.what_zh: 免費一年 HoteLux Elite Plus 會籍，豪華酒店優惠價另有禮遇。

perks.title: ALL Accor+ Explorer
perks.what: A free 12-month ALL Accor+ Explorer membership: dining discounts at Accor hotels and a free night.
perks.what_zh: 免費 12 個月 ALL Accor+ Explorer 會籍：Accor 酒店餐飲折扣及免費住宿一晚。

perks.title: withBanyan Voyager and a free night
perks.title_zh: withBanyan Voyager 會籍及免費一晚
perks.what: Voyager status at Banyan Group hotels and one complimentary night.
perks.what_zh: Banyan Group 酒店 Voyager 會籍，另送免費住宿一晚。

perks.title: Avis President's Club
perks.what: Avis President's Club status: priority service, a car upgrade and a free additional driver at participating locations.
perks.what_zh: Avis President's Club 會籍：優先服務、升級車款及免費加一位司機（參與分店適用）。

perks.title: Airport fast track
perks.what: Two airport fast-track passes a year through DragonPass.
perks.what_zh: 每年兩次 DragonPass 機場快速通道。

perks.title: Harrods Rewards Gold
perks.what: Free Harrods Rewards Gold tier for more points and perks at Harrods in London.
perks.what_zh: 免費 Harrods Rewards Gold 會籍，在倫敦 Harrods 賺更多積分及享更多禮遇。

perks.title: Trip.com Diamond
perks.what: A status match to Trip.com Diamond membership.
perks.what_zh: 配對 Trip.com Diamond 會籍。

perks.title: The New York Times
perks.what: A free one-year subscription to The New York Times.
perks.what_zh: 免費訂閱《紐約時報》一年。

perks.title: Visa Infinite Golf
perks.what: Free rounds at selected golf courses in Asia. Booking opens on the 1st of each month.
perks.what_zh: 亞洲指定高爾夫球場免費打球，每月 1 日開放預約。

cards.name: World Elite
cards.scope: Mastercard's own World Elite perks in Asia Pacific. Your bank adds its own (lounges, insurance, rewards).
cards.scope_zh: Mastercard 在亞太區的 World Elite 網絡禮遇。發卡銀行另有自家禮遇（貴賓室、保險、獎賞）。

perks.title: Mastercard Luxury Hotels & Resorts
perks.what: 3,800+ five-star hotels: daily breakfast for two, a hotel amenity worth up to US$100, upgrade and early check-in when available, check-out until 3pm.
perks.what_zh: 全球 3,800 多間五星級酒店：每日兩位早餐、價值最高 100 美元的酒店禮遇、視乎情況免費升級及提早入住、延遲至下午 3 時退房。

perks.title: HoteLux Elite Plus
perks.what: A free year of HoteLux Elite Plus: luxury hotel rates that can include daily breakfast and up to US$100 dining or spa credit per stay.
perks.what_zh: 免費一年 HoteLux Elite Plus 會籍：豪華酒店優惠價，或包每日早餐及每次入住最高 100 美元餐飲或水療消費額。

perks.title: Hotel elite status
perks.what: Instant or fast-track status with several hotel groups. Each has its own sign-up page.
perks.what_zh: 多個酒店集團即時或快速升級會籍，各有登記頁面。

perks.title: Avis President's Club
perks.what: Priority service, a guaranteed one-car upgrade at airports and railway stations, and a free additional driver. Varies by location.
perks.what_zh: 優先服務、機場及火車站保證升級一級、免費加一位司機。視乎地點而定。

perks.title: Travel eSIM
perks.what: A free FlexiRoam 3GB eSIM, valid 15 days in 150+ countries, once per calendar year.
perks.what_zh: 每年可免費領取一次 FlexiRoam 3GB eSIM，150 多個國家可用，有效 15 日。

cards.name: World Mastercard
cards.scope: World Mastercard has fewer network perks than World Elite. Your bank adds its own.
cards.scope_zh: World Mastercard 的網絡禮遇比 World Elite 少。發卡銀行另有自家禮遇。

perks.title: Mastercard Luxury Hotels & Resorts
perks.what: Daily breakfast for two, an amenity worth up to US$100, upgrade and early check-in when available, check-out until 3pm.
perks.what_zh: 每日兩位早餐、價值最高 100 美元的禮遇、視乎情況免費升級及提早入住、延遲至下午 3 時退房。

perks.title: HoteLux membership
perks.what: Free HoteLux membership for member rates at luxury hotels.
perks.what_zh: 免費 HoteLux 會籍，可享豪華酒店會員價。

cards.name: Platinum
cards.scope: The Hong Kong Platinum Card (charge card). Other countries' versions differ.
cards.scope_zh: 香港 Platinum Card（簽賬卡）。其他地區版本的禮遇不同。

perks.title: Fine Hotels + Resorts
perks.what: Daily breakfast, guaranteed 4pm check-out, upgrade when available and an on-property credit at participating hotels.
perks.what_zh: 參與酒店每日早餐、保證下午 4 時退房、視乎情況免費升級及酒店消費額。

perks.title: The Hotel Collection
perks.what: US$100 experience credit and upgrade when available, for stays of two nights or more.
perks.what_zh: 入住兩晚或以上可享 100 美元消費額，並視乎情況免費升級。

perks.title: Hotel elite status
perks.what: Gold or higher status with four hotel groups. Enrol for each one.
perks.what_zh: 四個酒店集團的金卡或以上會籍，須逐一登記。

perks.title: Platinum Vacation Credit
perks.what: Up to HK$4,500 back a year at Mandarin Oriental, The Peninsula and Club Med. Register first; a spending requirement applies.
perks.what_zh: 每年在文華東方、半島酒店及 Club Med 簽賬可獲最高 HK$4,500 回贈。須預先登記，並有簽賬要求。

perks.title: Hertz Gold Plus Rewards Five Star
perks.title_zh: Hertz Gold Plus Rewards Five Star
perks.what: Discounts, upgrades and priority service at Hertz. Enrol first.
perks.what_zh: Hertz 租車折扣、升級及優先服務。須先登記。

perks.title: Global Lounge Collection
perks.what: 1,550+ lounges in 500+ airports, including Centurion Lounges, Plaza Premium and Priority Pass.
perks.what_zh: 全球 500 多個機場、1,550 多間貴賓室，包括 Centurion Lounge、環亞機場貴賓室及 Priority Pass。

perks.title: Global Dining Credit
perks.what: HK$1,000 a year to spend on dining in Hong Kong, and HK$1,000 overseas.
perks.what_zh: 每年香港 HK$1,000 及海外 HK$1,000 餐飲簽賬額。

perks.title: Amex Gourmet Club
perks.what: Two-for-One courses and up to 30% off at 100+ restaurants.
perks.what_zh: 「買一送一」菜式，100 多間餐廳最高七折。

perks.title: city'super
perks.what: 3% off selected items at city'super and LOG-ON.
perks.what_zh: city'super 及 LOG-ON 指定貨品 97 折。

perks.title: Broadway Circuit cinemas
perks.what: Buy-1-Get-1-Free tickets on Fridays at Broadway Circuit cinemas.
perks.what_zh: 百老匯院線逢星期五買一送一。

perks.title: Travel insurance
perks.what: Worldwide travel cover when the trip is booked with the Platinum Card, plus purchase protection.
perks.what_zh: 以 Platinum Card 預訂行程即享全球旅遊保障，另有購物保障。

perks.title: Fine Hotels + Resorts
perks.what: Breakfast for two, a US$100 credit and other extras at participating hotels.
perks.what_zh: 參與酒店兩人早餐、100 美元消費額及其他禮遇。

perks.title: The Hotel Collection
perks.what: A US$100 credit and other extras at upscale hotels booked through Amex Travel.
perks.what_zh: 經 Amex Travel 預訂高級酒店可享 100 美元消費額等禮遇。

perks.title: A free hotel night
perks.what: One free night at a premium hotel every membership year.
perks.what_zh: 每個會籍年度可於高級酒店免費住宿一晚。

perks.title: Global Lounge Collection
perks.what: Over 1,550 airport lounges at 500 airports.
perks.what_zh: 全球 500 個機場逾 1,550 間貴賓室。

perks.title: Table for Two
perks.what: A free premium dinner for two every other month.
perks.what_zh: 每兩個月一次免費兩人高級晚餐。

perks.title: Love Dining
perks.what: Up to half off the bill at selected restaurants.
perks.what_zh: 指定餐廳最高半價。

perks.title: Regional golf
perks.what: Free green fees at 50+ golf clubs when you bring paying friends.
perks.what_zh: 與付費同伴同行，可於 50 多個高爾夫球會免果嶺費。

hk.scope: The Hong Kong Platinum Card (charge card).

sg.scope: The Singapore Platinum Card (charge card), S$1,744 a year.
sg.scope_zh: 新加坡 Platinum Card（簽賬卡），年費 S$1,744。
